remarks: Come check out this cute brick cape cod on one of Lackawanna's quaint streets. Sit and relax on your covered front porch before entering your charming home. Step inside from the foyer and enjoy your bright living room that features freshly painted walls, hardwood floors & newer windows. Your updated kitchen features vinyl flooring, new windows, gas stove, microwave & refrigerator. A bedroom & full bath complete the first floor. Upstairs has new carpet, 2 bedrooms with hardwood floors, newer windows & half bath. Basement is dry & has area for washer & dryer. Great to finish off or use for storage. Your backyard features a freshly painted deck with pergola, single car garage, fenced yard, just bring your flowers & grill. For piece of mind, the roof, HWT & furnace were replaced in 2024. Close to shopping, parks, golf course, thruway, Lake Erie, Botanical Gardens & Basilica. Open house Saturday, October 3, 2026, 11-l.
